programme.desc: While Green Lantern is having his spaceship repaired in the Batcave and the Batwheels want to play with his adorable alien pet! / After snagging an ultra-fuel-cell upgrade, Penguin’s Ducky Boat suddenly becomes the fastest vehicle in Gotham.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Bibi dismisses guarding a secret delivery at Gotham Docks as a minor task, allowing Poison Ivy to steal it. When Ivy uses a rare pollen-emitting flower to put all of Gotham into a deep sleep, Bibi must rescue her friends and restore order.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: After snagging an ultra-fuel-cell upgrade, Penguin’s Ducky Boat suddenly becomes the fastest vehicle in Gotham. Confident leader Bam must rally the Batwheels to stop the turbo-Ducky!

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: When Buff befriends Mr. Freeze’s snowcrawler Snowy, the other Batwheels bristle at the thought of hanging out with a “bad guy…” so Buff sets out to change their minds.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy – the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: All the Mushables have fun zooming down a long mudslide except Chep, who just can't get up the courage to do it. But when Fung and Miff tease him for being scared, he promises that he will do something that no Mushable has ever done before... ride a grasshopper! Chep is in for the ride of his life!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: When Lilit creates a "friends tree" mapping out who everyone is best friends with in Mushton, she realizes Muddler has no friends at all. Unable to accept this, Lilit slips away to try and befriend him. But Muddler's perception of friendship is somewhat unique, meaning Lilit now needs the help of her two best friends, Mush-Mush and Chep, to escape from Muddler's clutches.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Having rescued a Mushlet, Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit becomes heroes in Mushton, and they're loving it! So Mushlers create a rescue team... but, alas, no one needs saving! How can you be a hero when there is nothing to be heroic about?! Then when some Mushlets become adrift on the river, Team Mush-Mush, with Morel's help, have to save the day again.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: The Beacon Mushroom that guides the Mushables back to Mushton in the dark has gone out. So Lilit lights up and stands in its place for the night... and soon gets quite bored! Lilit's good deed has her regretting her gift - she's basically just a lamp! But when her light goes out, Lilit instantly regrets regretting it: she wants her gift back!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Every time Mush-Mush has tried to surprise his friend with a gift, Chep has always found out what it was. But Chep promises that this time he won't. And Lilit, who is too honest to keep a secret, promises she won't let Chep know what the surprise is. Both of them find this so hard! But Mush-Mush is one step ahead of them...

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Mushpie loves to sing. Only problem she is terrible at it! But Lilit, who has never heard her sing before, wants to make Mushpie happy and organizes a concert for her to sing in front of all the other Mushables... who are terrified at the idea! But Lilit doesn't have the heart to admit this to Mushpie.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: While fighting over a jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy and the Lemmings set off a chain reaction which sends the jar flying into space, where it damages the space station. Amongst the debris that falls in front of the cabin, the Lemmings discover a box that cancels out gravity.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a magician's hat that tosses out objects stored inside beforehand with the tap of a magic wand. He decides to impress his beloved she-bear with a magician's act. But he will have to work around the Lemmings, who have the gift of coming out of the hat at the wrong moment.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to try out the brand new packaging format of chocolate spread that he discovers in the ranger's cupboard: a yummy-looking XXL jar. And he does not intend to share it with the Lemmings. After observing a chameleon toad that is able to blend into its surroundings, the Lemmings decide to make themselves invisible to attain Grizzy's treasure.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: A magic tomahawk divides Grizzy into two identical bears with diametrically opposite personalities: one short-tempered, the other super-sweet. The Lemmings, who did not witness Grizzy's split, will have a hard time working out the behavior of their usual enemy, who seems to swing from excessive kindness to the worst trickery for no reason.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: After studying a magazine advertisement with a couple standing in front of an SUV, Grizzy imagines that if only he had a nice car, his favorite she-bear would be interested in him. He decides to confiscate the Lemmings crate on wheels and give it a serious overhaul. The Lemmings have nothing against an upgrade, as long as they remain behind the wheel!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: While chasing the Lemmings, who stole his jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy crashes into an arcade cabinet near the supermarket which displays a model fortune teller and her crystal ball. Grizzy realizes that he can foresee events that are going to happen to him in the crystal ball, and namely the traps that the Lemmings have planned for him.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: To make sure that the Lemmings don't snatch his chocolate spread while he's taking his nap, Grizzy turns the fridge into a safe - combination lock and all. The Lemmings try in vain to break into the fridge until they see Grizzy open the door while sleepwalking. Unfortunately, Grizzy wakes up at the crucial moment. The Lemmings do everything possible to make him fall back asleep as quick as possible.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: A newly unpacked UV tanning booth holds the place of honor in the middle of the cabin. Grizzy gets it into his head that a classy tan will help him draw the attention of the she-bear he's enamored with. When he opens the box, he discovers that the Lemmings have beat him to it and are already playing "beach party" inside the bed.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Fed up of driving Mrs Wicket everywhere, Mr Bean decides to teach her how to drive. He sets up a practice “car” in his flat using tin cans as pedals and household objects for all the levers. Mrs Wicket does so well that Mr Bean lets her have a proper lesson in his beloved car – but Mrs Wicket gets carried away in the real car, and it’s a white-knuckle ride!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants to take a photo of a rare bird, the Rosy Starling, hoping to win a cash prize from a nature magazine. But the special nuts he’s bought to lure the bird have instead attracted a couple of persistent squirrels, who keep hopping onto the bird table he’s installed and helping themselves to the tasty nuts. It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean buys himself a DIY remote-controlled boat kit so he can compete in a race on the local pond. But just as he’s about to finish it, Scrapper sniffs out some nearby sandwiches and causes havoc. In the confusion, Mr Bean thinks the cat has swallowed the rudder of his toy boat, so has to capture him and take him to the vet. Will he get his rudder back in time for the race?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are at the cinema to see the three hour long “Romance In Paris”, which Mr Bean is not looking forward to. But when he sees that they are also showing an action movie – Zombie Aliens 3 – he finds a way to sneak out and into the other screen. But will he get past the usher, and what will happen when Irma notices?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When a TV show offers cash to film in haunted homes, Mr Bean invites a film crew over and rigs his flat up to make it as spooky as possible – wobbly picture frames on wires, eerie noises on a tape recorder and a good old-fashioned sheet for a ghost. But will the tricks be convincing enough to win Mr Bean the money?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean rigs up his flat to make it seem haunted so he can win money from a TV show. / Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace goes missing while Mr Bean is fixing it – and he becomes the prime suspect! / Mr Bean accidentally shrinks all the jumpers from Irma’s knitwear stall. / Mr Bean runs a rigged tombola so he can raise money for a remote-controlled car.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: When the old Rooster Beetle comes to the end of his crowing days, everyone worries for Mush-Mush. ‘Rooster’ is Mush-Mush’s favourite. But Mush-Mush insists he is fine when everyoneknows he is not. So Mushpot and Starmush help him understand that it’s okay to show hisfeelings.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and friends "favourite play tree" the Fun Tree - is rotten and doomed. But Mush-Mush refuses to give up on it. In a last ditch effort to save the tree, our friends adventure off to try and track down the legendary Starmush, hoping his mysterious healing powers can save it.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: When Fung and Miff spoil Mush-Mush's fun tunnel surprise he has been working on for ages, he wishes their day was ruined too. And then it is, because they are taken by Muddler! Now our Mushlers have to go on a rescue mission to save Fung and Miff.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: When an egg blows down into the village, it is Mush-Mush and friends mission to return it to Mush Mountain. Two problems though: there is a Beetle Boom on and all the beetles try to charge and knock over Mushables, and Lilit has always wanted to see an egg hatch so secretly drags her feet...

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Lamput spends the day at the beach, and, in a pair of swimming trunks, cuts a fine figure indeed. That is to say; a small, round and blobby figure. It only takes one snide comment from a fellow beach-goer to bring Lamput's body issues to the surface. When you're a shape changer, though, there's no need for exercise; before long Lamput is strutting along as an orange amalgam of all the best-looking sunbakers. On the up side, it's a handy disguise when the Docs come a-hunting. On the down side? Well, it's kind of tiring pretending to be someone you're not. Lamput learns an important lesson from a nearby blobby little girl. Be yourself, and if anyone's got a problem with that, they can go find their own patch of sand.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Under the wood floor of the log cabin, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the entrance to an underground gallery with an old treasure card that indicates the location of a treasure. Upon closer look, the representation of this treasure greatly resembles a giant jar of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: When he brandishes a native american scepter that the Lemmings brought home with other antique objects, Grizzy sees the Lemmings bow low before him and behave like servants. One of them has escaped the spell, but he will have to confront both Grizzy and his fellow creatures in order to recover the scepter and reverse the spell.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy tries to impress the she-bear that he's in love with by making a sculpture of her from a piece of wood. But as soon as the artist's back is turned, the Lemmings gnaw at the work of art in order to transform it into a toboggan slide. Grizzy must succeed in getting rid of the Lemmings without his model realizing what's going on. An Art in itself!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings throw a surprise birthday party for one of the clan. When "Happy Birthday" rings out, the surpriiiiiise! is as great for Grizzy, who is trying to take a nap after a hearty meal, as it is for the birthday Lemming hero in question. From that point on, Grizzy has only one objective: stop the din, which is not at all helping his migraine headache. But for the Lemmings, the party must go on at any price.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: A gust of wind sweeps away the flower that Grizzy's adored she-bear wears in her hair. Grizzy sees this as a golden opportunity to dazzle her by bringing it back. But the Lemmings, who are riding on the back of a bucking caribou, realize that the flower makes their mount sneeze, which only makes the game ten times more fun!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy finds two identical vases that are actually communicating vessels in a Native American Indian chest. If he sticks his hand in one, it comes out the other, between them. This should satisfy Grizzy's natural lazy streak, regardless of the distance unless the Lemmings realize the incredible games they could play with the magic vases.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a vintage stopwatch in the garage which lets you wind back the minute that has just passed by and it can even stop time and movement in one's surroundings. This will give him a sure advantage over the Lemmings, provided of course they don't get their hands on it.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy is disturbed in the middle of his TV snack by a strange flow of incongruous objects that have been transformed into hot-air balloons. When he sees the Lemmings onboard these curious zeppelins, Grizzy understands that he will quickly have to confiscate their helium tank and balloons if he wants to relax in front of the TV.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers with great delight that the ranger has purchased a brand new multifunction Stressless recliner. But even an armchair designed for well-being - the ultimate in relaxation - can used for other purposes by the Lemmings, who transform it into a fearsome multi-game chair.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun – but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean fancies a game of golf so he creates his own golf course inside his flat and invites Irma to join him for a round. Their somewhat eccentric game takes them from sitting room to bathroom and through Mrs Wicket’s flat as they battle to be the winner of the First Bean Open Championship.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A crafty cat burglar is causing alarm and concern throughout the town with a series of daring rooftop robberies. After Mrs Wicket’s house is burgled and Bean has his wallet stolen he decides the only way to deal with this cunning housebreaker is to don a costume and become a superhero (like the ones in his favourite comic book). But Super Bean soon finds he has his hands full helping to rescue cats stuck in trees and old ladies with their spilled shopping.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Winter has come! The Baby Lemmings discover the pure joy of sliding and playing on the ice. Their neighbor Baby Moose is not at all as delighted with the new weather conditions as they are – already naturally fearful, he’s thrown into a complete panic when his surroundings turn icy, cold and… sharp! He decides to secure the zone by breaking up all the frozen ice puddles and smashing all the icicles in his vicinity including the Baby Lemmings’ icicles. But his phobia causes him to fall into the middle of a frozen lake, and the Baby Lemmings have to rescue him.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Baby Moose is dismayed by the recklessness of the Baby Lemmings, who wander through the forest oblivious to the dangers around them. Exhausted by having to save them from small dangers, he decides instead to teach them the rudiments of safety and equip them with protective gear. But the Baby Lemmings aren't too keen on this.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings are playing a game with a moss ball that falls apart too quickly. They discover a hazel tree with huge hazelnuts that are perfect for making their game even more fun! Their neighbor, Baby Chipmunk, who has the largest stockpile of hazelnuts in the whole forest and a veritable internal radar for detecting them, quickly realizes that the Baby Lemmings have found one. She can’t help but steal it for his own hoard. The Baby Lemmings realize that Baby Chipmunk hates to share so they decide to get their ball back and continue their game. Baby Chipmunk’s hoard is very well protected in a hollow tree, however.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Ranchers glide through the kelp forest, gathering fresh sea greens! Above them, the Tinhorns float in their family air balloon, tossing trash overboard and polluting the ocean! Peace turns to panic when Thunderfin, the island’s massive mosasaur, surges toward the Jetter! The Ranchers race to escape as the creature slams into the sub, but his movements aren’t just angry, they’re pained!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Ranchers are trying to wrangle a stubborn triceratops with a log jammed on her horn! Watching from the sidelines, Clara Tinhorn finds herself strangely charmed by the feisty creature, while Atticus has his eye on something shinier: the Ranchers' Jungle Jetter! Later that night, under cover of darkness; Clara, Atticus and their new dino friend sneak into the HQ with plans to snag the vehicle.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: When Ben interferes with a malicious magician's quest for the Earth-moving Titan Gloves at a swap meet, he accidentally switches bodies with Gwen, forcing both of them to see everything from each of their respective points of views.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: During a tour of the historic Oldeville, Ben discovers a rare Sumo Slammers card, but when Billy Billion claims that the item belongs to him, Ben soon finds himself battling Billy's advanced drones, which have also seized the Rust Bucket.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: When an Artificial Intelligence takes over the building of a trendy tech company, the gang has to solve the computerized mystery - and maybe learn a lesson about relying too much on technology.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: The Gang has seats on the largest airplane ever to fly the open airways! Unfortunately, the plane is also beset by a Gremlin bent on sabotaging the flight! The Gang has to step up to solve the airborne mystery as well as deal with something even scarier: Daphne in the pilot seat!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation – but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints – pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy – the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: When Gwen is confronted by Charmcaster looking to avenge Michael Morningstar, Gwen must prove to herself she's a worthy member of Team Tennyson.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: While bird watching at Pinnacles National Park, Gwen and Ben get into a competition of who can spot more birds first, but once a forrest fire interrupts their fun, Team Tennyson must hurry if they are to save the bird population and discover who is behind the suspiciously growing fire: Hex!

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: As Team Tennyson admires the efficiency of a super modern train station, Ben is quick to sniff out one of Steam Smythe's robots holding up the line, but once the fed up villain tricks our hero into accepting a duel, the fate of the Omnitrix hangs in the balance and it's up to Ben to set things right.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: A snowstorm rips the solar panels off the log cabin and Grizzy can no longer watch TV or enjoy the comforts of home! But he has a brilliant idea. He produces electricity by making a caribou run on a treadmill, using the last carrot in the house as bait. But the Lemmings absolutely want his carrot to make the perfect snowman.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers in shock that the TV has been replaced with a trompe-l’oeil image. Furious, he flushes the Lemmings out of their hiding place where they’d hoped to watch their favorite cartoon in peace and propels them as far as possible. They land in an ancient cave where a powerful spirit capable of entering individuals is asleep. The Lemmings decide to free the spirit and send it to Grizzy. But will they be able to control the spirit?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Not easy to enjoy a DVD about salmon when the Lemmings are having a disco party right there. Grizzy sends them packing with such force that they land at the research station, where they discover a state-of-the-art U.V. cabin. When turned up to the max, the light therapy and music options can advantageously replace the disco equipment Grizzy destroyed. The noise they make causes a block of ice to break off. It hurdles down the slope to the cabin and destroys Grizzy’s TV. But it doesn’t take the bear long to figure out that the U.V. cabin also has a DVD function.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun destroying ice towers. When Grizzy sees them, it inspires him to sculpt statues of himself. The Lemmings cannot resist the temptation to destroy the statues of Grizzy, who does everything in his power to protect them.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: A container adrift along the icefield will change the lives of Grizzy and the Lemmings: it’s an inexhaustible stock of chocolate spread! There is so much, that for the first time the close enemies have no need to fight over the treat. They entice a flock of penguins into hoisting the container out of the water. One of the penguins, who did not get his reward in fish, is disgruntled. Grizzy has him taste the Yummy, then throws the jar far away to get rid of the penguin. The chocolate treat spreads over the icefield. Fatal error?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy uses a fire extinguisher to chase the Lemmings from the living room so that he can take a nap, but the gadget accidentally flies out the window. It lands at the top of an ice cliff, causing a fissure, and the peak of the cliff topples. Amid the debris, the Lemmings discover a fearsome creature: the Yeti, who is looking for the guilty party. The Lemmings bring him to Grizzy, never dreaming that the giant will immediately fall in love with the Ranger’s cabin and throw a very original party.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show
programme.desc: Little Quacker develops the ability to sing like Pavarotti. But when Tom plots to use this to win a prize on the "Pets With Talent" TV show, Little Quacker refuses and Jerry covers for him. As things continue to snowball, it's up to Tom to attempt saving the day.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show

programme.desc: Starmush’s back is stuck, and the Mushelder has no choice but to ask for help in Mushton. Because Chep is the one that finds a solution to his back problem, Starmush chooses him to help with his daily activities. But Mush-Mush is jealous, he would have loved being the chosen one…

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings have turned the entire cabin topsy-turvy to organize medieval jousts with the ranger's fencing gear. Grizzy, who wishes to recover his couch, tries to straighten up, but is driven out by their fencing foils. To retaliate, Grizzy must find a blade equal to the task. He opts for a fine... frozen swordfish!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: A strange object is delivered to the Ranger's cabin: an over-board! It's a latest generation skateboard which levitates above the ground without wheels. The Lemmings immediately try to get their paws on it, but Grizzy also covets the board as a table to set his TV-dinners down on.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the joys of photography with the ranger's instant print camera. Grizzy would like to make a beautiful artistic portrait of the she-bear he's in love with, whereas the Lemmings prefer a group photo with a face-making competition: two radically opposed artistic trends!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The fridge in the cabin has changed: it's been replaced by a brand new state-of-the-art appliance which analyzes the body fat percentage of whoever wants to serve himself, before selecting the appropriate foodstuffs. For Grizzy, no question of touching the chocolate spread or sodas! Instead, to the Lemmings' delight, the fridge transforms into an extreme exercise machine.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy watches a demonstration of balloon modelling on TV. He decides to make a balloon poodle to offer to the she-bear he's enamored with. By observing Grizzy, the Lemmings discover with enthusiasm that you can blow up modelling balloons far more than regular ones, and that they end up exploding in a shower of tattered strips.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy needs a nice nap. He can't find a pillow comfortable enough to his taste until he tests the pillow that the Lemmings use as a high-jump mat. The pillow is so soft that Grizzy falls asleep the second he lays his head on it.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings have invented a new popcorn game which consists of throwing popcorn and catching it with their mouths. Grizzy notices that his lovely she-bear seems to be drawn by the scent of the grilled corn and decides to invite her over for a snack, just the two of them. But first, he must quickly recover the popcorn from the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy is awakened from his nap by the unpleasant, ongoing sound of Velcro strips being ripped off. The Lemmings have covered their bodies in Velcro and are throwing themselves against a doormat, which serves as their target. Grizzy finds peace and quiet by getting rid of the doormat until the Lemmings realize that bear fur is an ideal support for Velcro.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is off on a train trip but loses his ticket as he waves goodbye to Irma on the platform, so has to find ways of escaping the eagle-eyed ticket inspector. He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean has cleared up the leaves in Mrs Wicket’s path using a leafblower, but can’t find anywhere to put the heap he’s created. So he uses the power tool to blow the pile of leaves in a neat bundle along the street to find somewhere to dump them. Things take a turn when he inadvertently manages to foil a bank robbery with his new toy.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed – but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front – but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are invited across the road for dinner, and Mr Paliwal is particularly keen to show off his brand-new white sofa. As Mr Bean tests it out, he feels the squish of a chocolate bar in his back pocket and realises it’s gone all over the white cushions. Can Mr Bean clean the sofa before anyone notices?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some cash to take Scrapper to the pet groomer’s, he can’t believe the cost! Instead he buys a basic grooming kit, pockets the rest of the cash and gives the cat a makeover himself, without Mrs Wicket realising. Spotting a business opportunity, Mr Bean then sets himself up as a pet groomer in the back garden. But Mrs Wicket discovers she’s been tricked and now she wants revenge!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Chep is disappointed Mush-Mush and Lilit are too busy leaf-gliding to play moss-ball with him, so he hangs out with a new weevil friend instead. But Chep's new friend must migrate with all the other weevils -Except he doesn't know how to fly! Chep must teach him to fly while overcoming his own secret fear of heights.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: When Sushi-Mushi breaks the only spoon he has ever cooked with, he declares his cooking days are over! So Mush-Mush and friends step up to cook for everyone instead, how hard can it be? It turns out, very! The Mushlers will have to convince Sushi-Mushi he's still the best compost chef, even without his favorite spoon!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Chep wants to return a favour to Mush-Mush, but all Mush-Mush wants is to have a compost pancake on Pancake Day! But when the Food Snail falls for, and takes off after, the Travel Snail, Pancake Day has to be cancelled. Chep sees an opportunity to save the day for his friend! But er, how do you solve a snail falling for another?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: MM's favourite frog has had its home taken over by a lizard. Mushpot says not to interfere - nature must run its course. But Lilit feels so sorry for the frog she takes it back to Mushton where it causes havoc. Now our friends must lure the frog back to its home where it deals with the lizard itself.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: It's Fool The Forest Day when Mushables pull pranks, and MM has an epic one planned. But they spill Chanterelle's painting dye and instead must replace it by finding a rare Sloof beetle and milking it for its dye in front of everyone. Wait a minute! You can't milk a beetle! They've been pranked!

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Skinny might be a man of science, but he’s more than happy to get his fortune told for a laugh. The palm-reader sees alarming visions of Skinny’s near future; mostly visions that relate to Skinny being squashed, smooshed or otherwise smeared. It’s kind of Skinny’s own fault; maybe if he paid a bit less attention to chasing Lamput and a bit more attention to not getting squashed, smooshed or smeared, he wouldn’t need constant rescuing by a frazzled mystic.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings play kite-surf with a homemade kite. Grizzy notices that the she-bear he's in love with watches the kite perform arabesques in the sky with admiration. He decides to make a kite that is far more sophisticated than the Lemmings kite.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy snatches the last jar of chocolate spread out from under the noses of the Lemmings. In exchange, he offers them the toy stuck inside the lid: a mini-flute. When the Lemmings blow into the flute, the shrill notes that come out paralyze anyone whose ears aren't plugged for several seconds. They decide to play a tune for Grizzy in order to recover their share of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings play a new game, floating like flags in the breeze from the fan which is set at maximum. Grizzy, who has decided to watch his favorite TV documentary on salmon fish, quickly rids the living room of this interference. But he didn't anticipate that the Lemmings would continue their game on the roof with the wind pump and TV antenna, and that the interference would reappear... inside the TV!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a grand old time tearing down their Kapla block buildings, which they rebuild just as fast. Grizzy remarks that the she-bear he's in love with is impressed by the Lemmings' construction and makes believe that it's his work of art. But when the building collapses yet again, the she-bear walks off. Grizzy decides to build an even bigger one.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings draw inspiration from lessons they find in a martial arts book and start breaking every wooden object they can get their hands on into two. When Grizzy tries to stop them, they go on to the next lesson and get him in a judo hold. Grizzy understands that he needs the book so that he too can become a pro.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy dreams that he's a valiant knight who has just delivered his beloved. As he is about to take her in his arms, he is woken by the din of the Lemmings, who have chosen this particular day to blast music. Grizzy has only one desire: pick up his dream where he left off. But first, he'll have to stop the Lemmings' fiesta.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy stands in front of the pantry, desperate. The stock of chocolate spread is completely depleted. He realizes that the Lemmings are making some themselves, following a complicated recipe. If they can make it, then why can’t he?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Inspired by a magazine with a jewelry ad showing a man offering a diamond to a woman, Grizzy imagines himself offering the ranger's engagement ring to his beloved she-bear. But the big diamond set in the ring has disappeared. The Lemmings, who are having a spinning-top contest, are using it as the ultimate top. And they have no intention of giving it up.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: When he accidentally sticks a computer microprocessor to his temple, Grizzy is transformed into an exceptionally intelligent being capable of predicting events to come far in advance. With his way above average IQ, not only will he be able to provide himself with the latest high-tech comfort, getting rid of the Lemmings should be a piece of cake.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to stay in bed all day – even when making his breakfast, brushing his teeth and ordering a pizza! / Mr Paliwal has a new electric go-kart and challenges Mr Bean to a race – so he has to build one from scratch! / Mr Bean and Teddy go bowling - but it's hard work, especially when his fingers get stuck in a ball! / Mr Bean takes free food samples from a food truck at a market and sells them to raise funds for a teapot.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy go bowling - but it's hard work, especially when his fingers get stuck in a ball! / Mr Bean takes free food samples from a food truck at a market and sells them to raise funds for a teapot. / Mr Bean wants to watch his favourite TV show with Billy, but Mrs Wicket has other plans. / Mr Bean gate crashes an art exhibition opening party wearing a painted-on tuxedo!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall – right next to a man selling novelty teapots. Bean is instantly smitten with a green car-shaped one but can’t afford it. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase – “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is tidying his flat and chucking out a load of old unwanted junk. Unfortunately during the big clear out Teddy accidentally falls into a bin bag which gets put out in the street. Bean is horrified when the rubbish van arrives and he realises that dear old Teddy is now on his way to the landfill. Bean races across town to the dump but how will he ever find his friend amongst all the mountains of junk?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s newspaper keeps getting stolen. Who is the cunning culprit? / Mr Bean becomes a famous internet sensation. / Mr Bean ends up on stage at the opera house...in a dress! / Mr Bean becomes scoutmaster for the day but his obsession with badge collecting doesn’t win him any friends.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Baby lemmings discover that bouncing on mushrooms makes a bass drum sound. The rhythmic sound makes Baby Lynx want to dance. Seeing her, the baby lemmings discover the joys of dancing and dance with her. But Baby Lynx wants to remain the center of attention and prevents the lemmings from dancing. Meanwhile, the baby lemmings discover a cave with a crystal on the ceiling that turns into a sort of disco ball, creating a real dance hall where they'd rather Baby Lynx didn't come.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Baby Beaver tries to stockpile wood for construction by cutting down a few trees with his teeth. But it's a long and tedious process. When he realizes that Baby Lemmings are talented rodents, he tries to convince them to help him with his mission. But he doesn't anticipate the creative spirit of the Baby Lemmings, who can't be satisfied with just cutting logs without having fun!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: The baby lemmings have discovered a new creative passion: land art. By assembling different elements on the ground, they create a beautiful work of art that can be admired from above. Baby Raccoon is horrified by this activity, thinking that the baby lemmings are just making a mess. Baby Raccoon wants to tidy up what he perceives to be the mess made by the baby lemmings.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Dino Ranchers race to track down a high-pitched squeak. What they find is a baby Ankylosaurus, squeaking in panic as a pack of Raptors circles in for the attack! Springing into action, the team drives off the raptors and rescues the frightened little dino! Unbeknown to the Ranchers, the raptors follow them back to the Dino HQ, and they must know protect the baby dino once again

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The volcano on Dino Island is ready to blow! The Ranchers' mission: rescue a cluster of dino eggs too close to the volcano's fiery base before the heat turns their nests into ash! The operation hits a snag when a frantic Plesiosaur needs help! Jon frees the panicked creature, and the two become fast friends! He names her Noodles, and she's eager to help, maybe a little too eager!

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: While spending time in a peaceful coastal town, Ben faces the challenge of standing against his old adversary Steam Smythe and another of his strange creations, the Clocktopus, and also must face his deep, dark fear of squid.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: Ben and Gwen are transformed into babies by nanny-gone-nuts Nanny Nightmare who will stop at nothing to reshape the world in the image of her day-care.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: When Ben has to use one of his alien forms to save the Hoover Dam from disaster, he gets some help from tough guy and hero Tim Buktu, but Ben begins to question the "helper's" motives and has to decide if Tim is a friend or a foe.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: Ben, Gwen and Max go on a tour of the impervious Fort Knox when Dr. Animo sicks a hungry ani-mutate on the Fort.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: Ben and Gwen are excited to attend an Earth Day EDM concert in Portland until the show is hijacked by the sound-manipulating baddy Lord Decibel who uses sound as a weapon to trash the planet.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: Ben approaches Geezer Bob about doing a little yard work to earn spending money, but when Ben goes Upgrade to transform the lawnmower into a superfast mowing machine, he accidently draws the ire of Bob's gnome-neighbors, the tiny, terrifyingly tenacious Billy-Bob Goblins.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: After stumbling into Dr. Animo's secret lab filled with animals, Ben must formulate a plan that will allow him to set the animals free, but he has to get past the Alphas, the superior mutants that now rule the facility, and he's stuck as Stinkfly.

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: Ben and Gwen’s camping trip is interrupted by the emotionless Weatherheads but a malfunctioning Omnitrix firing out a mishmash of aliens may not be the forecast

programme.title: Ben 10
programme.desc: As Ben wanders through Yellowstone National Park, he ends up discovering the secret plot of an illegal racer known as Lagrange, who is on the hunt for some old treasure allegedly buried somewhere deep within the national park.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean cannot find anywhere to park other than the space he spots in a school’s car park. There’s a case of mistaken identity and Mr Bean finds himself teaching a class of unruly school kids. Bean uses every trick in the book to win them over and ends up teaching the headmaster how to be a success in school.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is in the library studying his family heritage. Someone brings to his attention Mr Bean’s resemblance to a certain Lord Bean. Mr Bean sets off to track down his ancestral home (a castle) in Scotland where he is welcomed with open arms. But owning a castle is not cheap. Can Mr Bean escape before he runs out of money and has there been a case of mistaken identity?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean and his beloved car find themselves in a crash for crash battle with his arch nemesis the Reliant Robin. It’s a contest to find out who can hold their nerve the longest. Does Mr Bean win? Is his car left unscathed? And more importantly do we find out who the driver of the Reliant Robin really is?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean has got everything ready for Irma’s birthday; card cake candles but he just needs to get her some flowers. But nothing goes to plan as Mr Bean inadvertently causes a car crash involving a bride on her wedding day. There’s no time to lose as Mr Bean promises he’ll get the bride to the church on time. Irma is not a happy lady as Mr Bean is distracted by the task in hand.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is keen to own a brand new smart phone when he discovers all the wonderful things it can do. But after a trip to the mobile phone shop he is horrified at how much they cost and decides to build his own one. Bean’s phone may be bulky but it comes with a whole range of built in gadgets especially useful during a race to The Tower of London.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A confused Japanese tourist couple mistake Mr Bean’s house for a hotel and because of the language barrier it is difficult to explain otherwise. When the hapless holidaymakers offer to pay to stay Mr Bean and Mrs Wicket see a way of making some money and pretend their house is indeed a hotel. But it’s not long before the tourists start to smell a fish.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is on a photography jaunt in the countryside snapping the normal everyday wildlife – a fox a bird a dinosaur! A DINOSAUR?!! Mr Bean is terrified until he realises what fame and fortune it could bring him. Does he get the photograph of a lifetime or is the situation not quite as it seems?

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean accidently causes Mrs Wicket to be hospitalised and in need of a wheelchair. Back home Mr Bean has thoughtfully set up a bell service so that he can be at Mrs Wicket’s beck and call at any time of day or night. Mrs Wicket likes this...a lot. The bell doesn’t stop ringing and an exhausted Mr Bean finds himself running up and down the stairs carrying and fetching until he eventually loses patience with his patient.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s car has broken down and he is late to meet Irma for a night at the opera. Mr Bean finally arrives but he is refused entry to the theatre because of his filthy attire. Forced to borrow some clothes from the local launderette Bean is mistaken for the star of the show and ends up on the stage giving the operatic performance of a lifetime.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When one of the toy cars of his racing track set becomes broken, Mr. Bean decides to buy a new one but since his Mini has a flat tire, he decides to take a taxi. The taxi driver deliberately drives around the town and stops for gas and lunch in the hopes of getting a higher fare. Bean tries to escape, but other passengers mistake Bean as the driver, and Bean reluctantly drives the taxi.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: The Scooby Gang enter Dickens' classic ?A Christmas Carol?, as they try to get to the bottom of the mysterious ghost tormenting Scrooge in 1843 England. Unfortunately, the Ghosts begin to convince Velma she's on a disastrous path of her own.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Unhappy about a mystery-free, three-day, cross-country train trip with the gang, Fred is pleasantly surprised to discover a monster mystery on board. He's less pleasantly surprised however, when that mystery is interrupted by a second mystery, then a third, then a fourth…

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: The gang goes trick or treating on Halloween night but Velma seems to think that Halloween is a disrespect to history while Daphne, Shaggy and Scooby have the opposite opinion. Meanwhile Fred believes you can't solve a mystery on Halloween. But all is explained when the gang runs into a witch and Fred reveals that he ran into the same witch 11 years ago with his cousin.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: On a trip to Japan to visit Velma's friend, the gang comes face to face with the ancient crab monster, Kaniaku, and attempts to solve a 700 year-old mystery. Meanwhile, Daphne accidentally becomes a viral media sensation in Japan!

programme.title: Moley: Squirm & Manny
programme.desc: Squirm and Manny are stargazing when some pesky fireflies buzz over and cause chaos!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Baby Beaver tries to stockpile wood for construction by cutting down a few trees with his teeth. But it's a long and tedious process. When he realizes that Baby Lemmings are talented rodents, he tries to convince them to help him with his mission. But he doesn't anticipate the creative spirit of the Baby Lemmings, who can't be satisfied with just cutting logs without having fun!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings are playing a game with a moss ball that falls apart too quickly. They discover a hazel tree with huge hazelnuts that are perfect for making their game even more fun! Their neighbor, Baby Chipmunk, who has the largest stockpile of hazelnuts in the whole forest and a veritable internal radar for detecting them, quickly realizes that the Baby Lemmings have found one. She can’t help but steal it for his own hoard. The Baby Lemmings realize that Baby Chipmunk hates to share so they decide to get their ball back and continue their game. Baby Chipmunk’s hoard is very well protected in a hollow tree, however.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: The baby lemmings have discovered a new creative passion: land art. By assembling different elements on the ground, they create a beautiful work of art that can be admired from above. Baby Raccoon is horrified by this activity, thinking that the baby lemmings are just making a mess. Baby Raccoon wants to tidy up what he perceives to be the mess made by the baby lemmings.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Alone in the jungle, Clara Tinhorn wrestles with her loneliness, until she stumbles upon a freshly hatched baby crocodile!She names the hatchling Lenny, and the two quickly bond in playful joy! When the Ranchers arrive to check on the crocodile nest, they discover the baby is gone! Furious, the mother croc, Snapfang, unleashes her wrath on the Ranchers, convinced they’ve stolen her child!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Ranchers dive deep across the ocean floor, determined to track down Jack’s long-lost rusty anchor! Their search is a success, but the moment they reach for it, the water explodes with motion! A massive plesiosaur charges at them, sending the Ranchers close to the wreck of an ancient ship! Just when a collision seems certain, the beast halts, spooked by something lurking in the depths!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Wedged in his sofa to relieve his aching back, Grizzy balks at getting up. He designs clever strategies to do everything from a distance, including confiscating the Lemming's radio-controlled toy robot-transformer which he will use as a butler.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The vibrations created by Grizzy's snoring during his nap give the Lemmings an idea for a bouncing game. But when Grizzy changes positions and his snoring stops, the Lemmings must find other sources of vibrations. Only these are no longer compatible with Grizzy's nap.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a birthday piñata in the ranger's living room. The idea of bursting open a papier-mâché statue with a bat like it says in the instructions pleases him. The Lemmings, who prefer to use it as a toy to swing from, are determined to stop Grizzy from destroying the piñata.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Inside a mysterious cave, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a magical Game of the Goose. The events displayed in the squares that the players land on come true in real life. When Grizzy and the Lemmings realize, it's too late to stop the game.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy is bothered by an object stuck in between the sofa cushions: a big fur lemming puppet glove. He puts his hand inside and has fun pretending that the puppet is strangling him. The Lemmings believe that the puppet is a Super Lemming who's stronger than Grizzy and start to obey it.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the leftovers of a Halloween party in the ranger's cabin, which was entirely redecorated for the occasion, with stupefaction. But if the curious ambiance perturbs Grizzy, the Lemmings are in seventh heaven and have a whale of a time jumping up and down inside a cooking pot full of marshmallows. Grizzy wants to get rid of it until he accidentally swallows a marshmallow and discovers the best flavor of his life.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to give the she-bear he's in love with a plastic ring which he finds really swell. But since the object was found in the trash, he needs to wash it first. And the Lemmings are using the sole bar of soap in the house as a bobsleigh.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a strange American Indian figurine with the power to switch the spirits of two living beings and finds himself imprisoned in the body of a caribou. He immediately tries to activate the reverse procedure, but the Lemmings steal the figurine in order to turn into a partridge and fly away.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: While salmon fishing on the riverbank, Grizzy hauls in an unusual catch: an old hand mirror straight out of a fairytale. Instead of showing the reflection of the person who holds it, the mirror shows an idealized vision of his surroundings. Whether it be Grizzy or the Lemmings, everyone sees the world of his dreams, and no one wants to share it.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.desc: Hyppelihiiri Myökki-Pyökki-metsässä perustuu norjalaisen Thorbjørn Egnerin samannimiseen satuklassikkoon, joka on valloittanut lukijoita 1950-luvulta alkaen. Hurmaavana nukkeanimaationa toteutettu elokuva kertoo Hyppelihiiren, Martti Metsähiiren, leipurimestari Jänöliinin ja heidän eläinystäviensä elämästä Myökki-Pyökki-metsässä. Metsä on muuten mukava paikka asua, mutta pienten eläinten on jatkuvasti varottava isompiaan - erityisesti Mikko Repolaista. Kun Samuli Siilikin yrittää syödä suihinsa Martti Metsähiiren mummon, on korkea aika säätää laki, jotta elämään metsässä saataisiin tolkku: tästedes kaikkien metsän eläinten tulee olla ystäviä eikä kukaan saa syödä toista.

programme.title: Petteri Kaniini: Kani karkuteillä (0)
programme.desc: Kaikkien rakastama veijari palaa ruudulle Petteri Kaniini: Kani karkuteillä - elokuvan myötä. Bea, Tuomas ja kaniinit ovat muodostaneet oman perheensä, mutta Petteri ei yrityksistään huolimatta pääse eroon maineestaan kiusantekijänä. Petteri lähtee seikkailemaan puutarhan ulkopuolelle ja päätyy maailmaan, jossa arvostetaan ilkikurisuutta, mutta kun hänen perheensä lähtee riskeistä huolimatta etsimään häntä, hänen on päätettävä, millainen kaniini hän haluaa olla.

Vahvistaakseen perheenjäsenten välistä sidettä he päättävät ahtaa Wednesdayn, Pugsleyn, Fester-sedän ja muun poppoon kauhistuttavaan asuntoautoonsa ja lähteä tien päälle viimeiselle yhteiselle, kurjalle perhelomalle.

programme.title: Up and Away (0)
programme.desc: Hodja haaveilee muustakin kuin isänsä räätäliliikkeen haltuunotosta. Kun Hodjalle annetaan lentävä matto, jolla hän voi lähteä hakemaan uutta mattoa matonmyyjälle, hän lentää pois ilman isänsä lupaa.

programme.title: Hyppelihiiri Myökki-Pyökki-metsässä (7)
programme.desc: Hyppelihiiri Myökki-Pyökki-metsässä perustuu norjalaisen Thorbjørn Egnerin samannimiseen satuklassikkoon, joka on valloittanut lukijoita 1950-luvulta alkaen. Hurmaavana nukkeanimaationa toteutettu elokuva kertoo Hyppelihiiren, Martti Metsähiiren, leipurimestari Jänöliinin ja heidän eläinystäviensä elämästä Myökki-Pyökki-metsässä. Metsä on muuten mukava paikka asua, mutta pienten eläinten on jatkuvasti varottava isompiaan - erityisesti Mikko Repolaista. Kun Samuli Siilikin yrittää syödä suihinsa Martti Metsähiiren mummon, on korkea aika säätää laki, jotta elämään metsässä saataisiin tolkku: tästedes kaikkien metsän eläinten tulee olla ystäviä eikä kukaan saa syödä toista.

programme.title: Petteri Kaniini: Kani karkuteillä (0)
programme.desc: Kaikkien rakastama veijari palaa ruudulle Petteri Kaniini: Kani karkuteillä - elokuvan myötä. Bea, Tuomas ja kaniinit ovat muodostaneet oman perheensä, mutta Petteri ei yrityksistään huolimatta pääse eroon maineestaan kiusantekijänä. Petteri lähtee seikkailemaan puutarhan ulkopuolelle ja päätyy maailmaan, jossa arvostetaan ilkikurisuutta, mutta kun hänen perheensä lähtee riskeistä huolimatta etsimään häntä, hänen on päätettävä, millainen kaniini hän haluaa olla.

programme.title: Bamse ja jymykello (0)
programme.desc: Tulipalossa tuhoutuu isoäidin jymykellovarasto, josta valmistetaan Bamsen jymyhunajaa tekemään hänestä maailman vahvin nalle. Bamse ei voi enää muuttua vahvaksi, joten nyt ovat hyvät neuvot kalliit. Kilpinen ja Pomppi lähtevät merelle etsimään lisää jymykelloja mystiseltä Kalliosaarelta. Bamse jää kotiin pitämään Kumpulan roistot kurissa, vaikka hän on menettänyt jymyvoimansa. Onneksi roistot eivät ainakaan vielä tiedä, että Bamsen jymyhunaja on loppu...

programme.title: My Robot Brother (7)
programme.desc: Lähitulevaisuudessa on valoisaa, vihreää ja ihanaa – ja jokaisella lapsella on jopa oma ihmisenkaltainen robotti. 12-vuotiaalla Albertella sen sijaan on hyvin vanhanaikainen robotti, joka lähinnä muistuttaa isoa nallea. Albertesta tulee suosittu, kun hän saa syntymäpäivälahjaksi markkinoiden uusimman humanoidimallin. Hän on Konrad, aidoimman oloinen robotti, jota koskaan on nähty. Vähitellen Alberte alkaa tuntea aitoa yhteyttä Konradiin – mutta voiko ihminen ylipäätään olla ystävä robotin kanssa?

programme.title: Asterix: Jumaltenrannan nousu ja tuho (7)
programme.desc: Julius Caesar paljastaa uusimman suunnitelmansa päästä eroon sinnikkäistä gallialaisista lopullisesti. Koska hänen armeijansa ei ole onnistunut nujertamaan tätä viimeistä vastarinnan saareketta, hän päättää kokeilla yllätyshyökkäystä: sivilisaation tuomista kylän porteille! Hän rakentaa uuden Rooman - Jumaltenrannan - Asterixin kylän ympärille, painostaen gallialaiset joko omaksumaan kulttuurin tai lähtemään. Huolimatta Asterixin ja Obelixin suunnitelmista pysäyttää rakennustyöt, alkavat rakennukset pian nousta ja Rooman kansalaiset saapuvat valtaamaan heidän asuinaluettaan, aiheuttaen kaaoksen Asterixin kylään. Tarkoittaako tämä lopultakin Caesarin voittoa?

programme.title: The Grinch (7)
programme.desc: Varokaa kaikki! Hän on vihreä, häijy eikä pidä joulusta! The Grinch on pahantuulinen karvaisa vihreä otus, joka asuu luolassa Mount Crumpit -vuorella Whovillen kylän yllä. Kun Whovillen väki valmistautuu kiihkeästi joulupyhien viettoon, The Grinch päättää hankkiutua joulusta eroon lopullisesti ja varastaa kaikki lahjat ja koristeet jouluaattona... Kunnes saa huomata, että joulussa on kyse paljosta muustakin kuin kiillosta ja leluista. Hauska Jim Carrey herättää The Grinchin eloon komeasti tässä maagisessa live action -komediassa, joka perustuu viehättävän omituiseen ja rakastettuun Dr. Seussin kirjaan ”How the Grinch Stole Christmas”.

programme.title: Hitch (12)
programme.desc: Esittelemme Hitchin, New Yorkin parhaan lemmentohtorin. Rakkaus on hänen alaansa – hänen avullaan saat takuuvarmasti unelmiesi naisen vain muutamien treffien jälkeen! Täsmälleen niin tapahtuukin, kun Albert Brennaman voittaa upean seurapiirikuningattaren Allegra Colen sydämen. Kun juorukolumnisti Sara Melas päättää paljastaa puuhakkaan pullukan menestyksen salaisuuden, hän järkyttyy havaitessaan, että komea nuori mies Alex Hitchens, jota hän on tapaillut, onkin kuuluisa deittitohtori. Etusivun lööppiin jouduttuaan Alexin täytyy yrittää pelastaa Albertin ja Allegran välinen suhde – ja oma suhteensa. Aina kun luulet löytäneesi aidon rakkauden, jutussa onkin jokin juoni.

programme.title: Mitä nainen haluaa (12)
programme.desc: Jokseenkin sovinistisen mainosmiehen Nickin elämä menee sekaisin, kun hän saa yllättäen kyvyn kuulla naisten ajatukset. Ensin hän tahtoisi kyvystä eroon, mutta hänen psykiatrinsa vakuuttaa hänelle, että kyvystä voi olla paljon hyötyäkin.

programme.title: Forever My Girl (7)
programme.desc: Kantrin supertähti Liam Page (Alex Roe) valitsi maineen ja mammonan ja jätti Josien (Jessica Rothe) alttarille kahdeksan vuotta sitten. Kun mies palaa kotikaupunkiinsa ystävänsä hautajaisia varten, hän joutuu kohtaamaan tekojensa seuraukset.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife (12)
programme.desc: Ohjaaja Jason Reitmanilta ja tuottaja Ivan Reitmanilta tulee seuraava osa alkuperäiseen Ghostbusters-sarjaan. Elokuvassa Ghostbusters: Afterlife yksihuoltajaäiti kahden lapsensa kanssa saapuu pikkukaupunkiin ja alkaa huomata yhteyden alkuperäisiin ghostbusterseihin ja isoisänsä jättämään salaiseen perintöön. Käsikirjoittajina Gil Kenan ja Jason Reitman.

programme.title: Nanny Mcphee And The Big Bang (0)
programme.desc: Nanny McPhee saapuu auttamaan äitiä, jolla on hoidettavanaan kolme lasta ja maatila. Isä on sodassa, ja äiti saa hoidettavakseen myös lasten kaksi hemmoteltua kaupunkilaisserkkua. Päänvaivaa aiheuttaa myös miehen veli, joka yrittää saada kepulikonsteilla myytyä maatilan. 105 min. Ohjaus: Susanna White. Pääosissa: Ralph Fiennes, Emma Thompson, Maggie Gyllenhaal. (perhe, USA, 2010)

programme.title: Utelias Vili (0)
programme.desc: Pikkuinen suosikkiapinamme Utelias Vili valloittaa nyt ensimmäistä kertaa koko perheen animaatioelokuvassa, jonka alkuperäisääninä kuullaan Will Ferrell ja Drew Barrymore. Utelias pikkukaveri Vili, jolla on kyltymätön seikkailunnälkä, tapaa Keltahattuisen miehen ja päätyy seuraamaan tätä suurkaupunkiin. Vilin uteliaisuus saattaa hänet ja hänen uuden ihmisystävänsä monenlaisiin hankaluuksiin – ja hauskoihin tilanteisiin! Maailman ilkikurisin apina on tullut viidakosta kaupunkiin etsimään uusia seikkailuja! Uteliaan Vilin hauskat, jännittävät ja viihdyttävät seikkailut naurattavat yhä uudestaan!

programme.title: Sing 2 (0)
programme.desc: Buster onnistui tekemääm New Moon Theatresta paikallisen menestystarinan. Hänellä on kuitenkin suuremmat tavoitteet: luoda esitys Redshore Cityn glamourin täyttämään Crystal Tower Theatreen.

programme.title: Yö eläintarhassa (7)
programme.desc: Kun meteori iskee eläintarhaan, virus muuttaa eläimet kuolaaviksi zombimaisiksi mutanteiksi. Nuori omalaatuinen susi Gracie liittoutuu karun vuorileijonan Danin kanssa löytääkseen takaisin laumaansa. Kun eläintarha ajautuu kaaokseen, heidän on keksittävä keino palauttaa eläimet ennalleen.

programme.title: Lemmikkien salainen elämä (0)
programme.desc: Huippumenestyneiden Itse ilkimys -elokuvien tekijöiden pitkä animaatio antaa vihdoin vastauksen kysymykseen: mitä lemmikkisi puuhaavat sinun poissa ollessasi? Kun omistajat lähtevät päiväksi kotoa, rakennuksen lemmikit juoruilevat ystäviensä kanssa, tyydyttävät makeanhimonsa ja pitävät hurjia juhlia. Kun lellitty terrieri ja hänen vallaton uusi "kämppiksensä" eksyvät New York Cityn asfalttiviidakkoon, heidän on unohdettava erilaisuutensa selvitäkseen eeppisestä matkasta takaisin kotiin.

programme.title: Pienin painajainen perheessä (12)
programme.desc: Greg Focker (Ben Stiller) on vihdoinkin alkanut ansaita appiukkonsa, entisen CIA-agentin Jack Byrnesin (Robert DeNiro) arvostusta. Mutta yksi tulikoe on vielä edessä: pystyykö Greg osoittamaan, että hänessä on miestä olla perheen pää... vai mureneeko luottamus lopullisesti? Edellisistä osista tutut Owen Wilson, Blythe Danner, Teri Polo, Dustin Hoffman ja Barbra Streisand saavat seurakseen Jessica Alban, Laura Dernin ja Harvey Keitelin tässä hulvattomassa perhetarinassa.

programme.title: Unta vai rakkautta (0)
programme.desc: Romanttinen hittikomedia sai koko maailman ihastumaan Sandra Bullockiin. Bullock esittää Lucya, yksinäistä metrotryöntekijää, joka ihastuu komeaan muukalaiseen (Peter Gallagher). Kun Lucy pelastaa ryöstön uhriksi jääneen ja koomaan vaipuneen komistuksen, miehen omituinen perhe luulee Lucya morsiameksi! Sekasotku vain syvenee, kun Lucy alkaa sepittää perheelle tarinaa parisuhteestaan ventovieraan kanssa. Lopulta Lucy ihastuu koomapotilaan hurmaavaan veljeen (Bill Pullman), ja soppa alkaa olla jo melko sakeaa. On pakko valita jompikumpi!

programme.title: Merikapteeni Santiago
programme.desc: Kun Lotta Luinen varastaa merirosvoaarteen, Santiago oppii miten paljon hän tarvitsee miehistöään. // Santi ja hänen miehistönsä seilaavat Banaanisaarelle pelastamaan apinavauvan ja sen aarteen Enriquen käsistä.

programme.title: Merikapteeni Santiago
programme.desc: Kun Escarlata kajauttaa ilmoille lumotun kitarariffin, merenalainen elämä on vaarassa langeta loitsun pauloihin. // Tomás muttaa Abuelon vahingossa kanaksi!

programme.title: Sinä ja Sinin arvoitukset
programme.desc: Talossa äänestetään uudesta lemmikistä, ja vastakkain ovat hamsteri ja kultakala. Tasatilanteessa selvitämme Sinin arvoitusleikillä, kuka saa antaa viimeisen ja ratkaisevan äänen.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Neiti Jänis patistaa Äiti Possun rentoutustunnille, jossa hän voisi vähän hengähtää.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Jyri syö aamupalansa liian nopeasti ja hänelle tulee hikka. Pipsasta se on aluksi hauskaa, mutta kun Jyrin hikottelu alkaa pilata heidän pelinsä, Pipsa päättää parantaa Jyrin omalla erityisellä tavallaan. Pipsa ei opi Jyrin virheestä, vaan hän juo mehunsa nopeasti... hik! Pipsallekin tulee hikka.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Pipsan kaikki kaverit pyöräilevät polkupyörillä. Kun Pipsa kiusaa Jyriä siitä, että tällä on vauvojen kolmipyörä, muuta lapset huomauttavat, ettei Pipsakaan kovin iso tyttö ole, koska hän tarvitsee vielä apupyöriä. Pipsa päättää oppivansa pyöräilemään ilman niitä ja oppiikin isäpossun avustuksella, mutta ei ilman pientä kolhua.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Äitipossu on tehnyt Pipsalle oman salaisen laatikon. Jyri haluaa tietää, mitä Pipsan laatikossa on. Jyrikin saa oman salaisen laatikkonsa, ja Pipsa haluaisi tietää, mitä siellä on.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Pipsa, Jyri, äiti- ja isäpossu lennättävät leijaa puistossa. Kaikki ei suju suunnitelmien mukaan ja leija sotkeutuu puuhun, joka on mutalammikon vieressä. Äitipossu ei halua, että Jyri ja Pipsa tulevat mutaisiksi, mutta kun isäpossu putoaa lammikkoon ja mutaa lentää kaikkien päälle, mutalammikossa hyppelystä ei ole enää haittaa.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Perhe lähtee eväsretkelle. Pipsa ja Jyri löytävät pienen lammen ja syöttävät ankoille leipää. Äitipossun herkullinen mansikkakakku houkuttelee paikalle ampiaisia, jotka jahtaavat isäpossua retkipaikan ympäri.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Äitipossu ja isäpossu ovat siivonneet taloa. He ovat löytäneet laatikon, jossa on soittimia. Pipsa ja Jyri haluavat kokeilla viulua, sitten rumpua ja harmonikkaa.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Pipsa ja Jyri leikkivät vaaripossun puutarhassa. Pipsa esittää perhosta. Vaaripossu näyttää Jyrille, miten esittää kiemurtelevaa matoa. Sitten Pipsa, Jyri ja vaaripossu pitävät hauskaa mutalätäköissä hyppien ja sammakoita leikkien.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Peppa ja George ottavat vanhempiensa vaatteita ja pukevat ne ylleen. Ne ovat liian suuria, mutta he tuntevat itsensä suuriksi ja Peppa käyttää äidin tietokonetta, kun taas George hoitaa isän puutarhaa!

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Äitipossu ostaa Pipsalle parin kiiltävänpunaisia kenkiä. Pipsa pitää uusista kengistään niin paljon, ettei hän halua ottaa niitä pois, ei edes kylpyä varten! Yösateen jälkeen puutarha on todella märkä. Äiti-, isäpossu ja Jyri laittavat kumisaappaat jalkaan ja lähtevät etsimään mutalammikoita, joissa voisi hyppiä. Pipsa haluaisi liittyä seuraan, mutta hänellä on vielä uudet, kiiltävät kenkänsä...

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Pipsa lähtee perheineen koulun juhlaan. Pipsan, Jyrin ja heidän ystäviensä kasvot maalataan tiikereiksi. Kaikki lapset saavat ilmapallot ja fiksu isäpossu tekee kaikkiin vaikutuksen, kun hän tekee dinosauruksen muotoisen ilmapallon Jyrille. Mutta vetonaulana on pomppulinna!

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: On äitipossun syntymäpäivä. Pipsa, Jyri ja isäpossu ovat yhtä innoissaan kuin äitipossukin. Heillä on hauskaa valmistellessaan salaista syntymäpäiväyllätystä äitipossulle. Kun äitipossu näkee kauniin kakkunsa ja avaa lahjansa hän on iloinen.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Matelijoiden kuningatar on tulossa Iisan puutarhaan, mutta valmistelut ovat pahasti kesken! Siispä Dora auttaa Iisaa. / Dora kohtaa Lami-laiskiaisen, jolla on kiire leirille näyttämään kaikille hieno yllätys.

programme.title: Herra Krokotiili
programme.desc: Herra Krokotiili ja Daisy auttavat Kiaraa ja Amiria sopimaan erimielisyyden. // Daisy ja herra Krokotiili ryhtyvät aarrejahtiin, kun Roland löytää isoisänsä aarrekartan.

programme.title: Barbapapan perhe
programme.desc: Barbapupu julistaa perhelleen, että haluaa alkaa prinsessaksi. // Barbapaavo on tylsistynyt, sillä hänen sisaruksensa ovat kiireisiä eivätkä halua leikkiä hänen kanssaan.

programme.title: Rubble & kaverit
programme.desc: Rubblen ryhmä rakentaa kengurusafarin Lucasille ja Lilylle. Ongelmia tulee, kun raksakengurut hyppivät tiehensä! // Nopsa Nikkari haastaa Rubblen ryhmän kisailemaan Pulttipoukaman ensimmäisissä rakentamiskilpailuissa.

programme.title: Merikapteeni Santiago
programme.desc: Löydettyään kosmisen aarrekartan, Santiago ja hänen miehistönsä kurkottavat tähtiin jäljittääkseen aarteen. // Kiko ja herra Voisilmä vaihtavat paikkaa kesken kahakan.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Vaari Possu haluaa viedä Pepan ja Georgen purjeveneilemään, mutta hänen veneensä on uponnut. Pappa Kani tulee ilmatyynyaluksellaan, ja he lähtevät retkelle.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Pappa Possu kertoo Pipsalle ja Jyrille lelulentokoneiden rakentamisesta. Hänellä on vielä yksi erityinen kone, jota Mummo Possu ei ole nähnyt.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu
programme.desc: Pipsa piirtää hienon kuvan talostaan ja saa ensimmäisen leikkikerhon tähden.

programme.title: Pipsa Possu

Lotan isä onkin juuri sopivasti saanut valmiiksi lentävän koneen. Isän ystävä, vanha matkaajakoira Klaus, kutsutaan matkalle mukaan, ja näin jännittävä matka kohti etelää alkaa. Virolainen suomeksi puhuttu animaatiosarja.
